participation.context: Kept the comedy and the Holinshed, gave the ages at home, and said the streets were quiet enough.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Gave the comedy back in two parts, named forty pence, asked for the Holinshed, and did not ask a second time about the streets.
participation.name: Richard Field

participation.context: Fed them, said both men were right, and turned the talk from the streets to the corn.
participation.name: Jacqueline Field

relations.note: he wants the copy and will not have it
relations.quote: Then one day a Millington will have it from a hired man for forty pence.

story.body: You ate with Richard and Jacqueline and would not give him the comedy. The copy stays with Garnish and the company. You refused the chronicle again. Asked about the streets, you said quiet enough, and stopped.

relations.note: he wants the copy and will not have it
relations.quote: Then one day a Millington will have it from a hired man for forty pence.

title: Refused Field the comedy and called the streets quiet enough
